newsitem.title: UK: London Elec shuffles board before takeover.
newsitem.headline: London Elec shuffles board before takeover.

text.p: Shareholders in London Electricity, the British power supplier that has agreed to a 1.27 billion stg takeover by U.S. utility Entergy, agreed to a board reshuffle on Thursday.
Following a board meeting, Edwin Lupberger, the chairman, president and chief executive officer of Entergy, was appointed chairman of London Electricity.
Michael Bemis, formerly vice president of international retail operations, becomes chief executive.
The former chairman of London Electricity, Sir Bob Reid, has resigned along with other non-executive directors Judith Hanratty, Gordon Owen and Leslie Priestly.
London's former chief executive Mike Kersey remains on the board although a company spokeswoman said it was too soon to say what his new job would be.
